reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.F013_forward: Use the member-specific abstraction map/relation for its stated native predicate. An overapproximation may establish a matching universal exclusion; a concretely feasible witness may establish existence. Information, probability or relational claims require the stronger property-specific condition stated by the member.
common.F013_reverse: The native outcome, domain and intended quantifier select what the displayed abstraction must preserve and whether omitted distinctions or spurious behaviors matter. This requirement is independent of proving that a chosen abstraction has that property.
common.F014_forward: The stated concrete-to-abstract or old-to-new semantic relation supplies one actual preservation edge for the native inference. Credit only the property licensed by that relation, with environmental/application correspondence separate. Trace inclusion alone is not every quantitative, relational or information-preservation result.
common.F014_reverse: The native property selects the exact observations, state relation, weights, denominators or temporal distinctions the proposed refinement must retain. It can show that ordinary behavior inclusion is sufficient for a universal property, or inadequate for the stronger intended claim; it does not itself prove refinement.
common.F016_forward: Correct complete exploration of the declared finite object establishes its exact finite predicate or exhibits a violating member. This is a real model/computation input at that bound, including a useful counterexample to an overbroad claim. It is not an empirical sample or a proof for every larger domain.
common.F016_reverse: The native predicate and specified finite domain determine what must be enumerated, which variables and constraints are consequential, and whether complete enumeration answers the full selected question or only its bounded subclaim. They do not make an unfinished search complete.
common.F018_forward: The actual bound and completion status limit evidence from checking this named formal/computational object. Keep a legitimate bounded result; an extension needs a separate completeness, induction, analytic or correspondence argument. Finite field exposure is not bounded model checking.
common.F018_reverse: The native domain and intended claim determine which bound is meaningful and what would be required to extend beyond it. They identify when the finite object is already the whole selected model, rather than requiring endless larger runs.
common.semantics_guard: Match source/target observation maps, supported arithmetic, nondeterminism, probabilities, clocks, fairness and the exact property class. Preserve an exact real quantity only with an appropriate mathematical/evaluation argument; finite floating computations need stated error interpretation. A representation or title does not establish a semantic relation.
common.positive_and_negative_controls: Already executed NX04 rejects a blanket claim that restriction destroys every hyperproperty: its universal pair property is subset-closed, while possible-output-set equality is not. NX07 shows equal marginals do not preserve a joint-law result. NX08 has a 31-history finite domain and a separate all-integer sequence argument; zero-only histories fail to expose the wrong copier. Those cases remain their own attribution.
common.cost: Prefer an exact small object, a short direct witness, an existing conditional theorem or a direct algebraic proof when sufficient. Refinement/abstraction and larger finite bounds add proof and maintenance cost; no method or artifact is compulsory and no performance gain is claimed.
common.execution: Own author-exposed analytical correspondence. No new model checker, solver or model-case program is run. Existing native/own cases are reused as evidence at their exact bounds; the definitions below are not reported as checked executions.

native_members.specific_semantic_correspondence: Project the NX01-style world to its actual timeout observation and present-state objective. Preserve both relevant past-effect possibilities in an observation fiber when claiming ambiguity; a one-sided abstraction may prove a universal current postcondition without proving exact historical ignorance.

Project runtime executions to the actual enclosed state/effect boundary. Preserve the internal processing predicate; discarded external effects stay excluded and cannot receive transferred completion credit.

Map repeated attempts to their stable intent plus immutable parameters and principal. Forgetting attempt-local noise can be harmless, while forgetting intent identity or tenant binding can remove the decisive duplicate distinction.

Map concrete response/exception cases to the producer guarantee used by the actual consumer implication. A valid coarse postcondition may be sufficient; dropping a consumer-required result is not a sound abstraction for that use.

Map the observed probe to its capability/path/time assertion. The abstraction must retain the particular capability and relevant interval; removing those labels can turn a correct read witness into an unsupported write/current-health claim.

Abstract the local and proposed remote alternatives to the specific needed invariant/capability and dependency obligations. Exclude neither a legitimate local solution nor a consequential remote capability; do not transfer a bounded capability result into a global cost optimum.

Project the removal dependency relation only after retaining each consequential current or dormant obligation. Recent-call traces alone underapproximate possible consumers and cannot establish universal removal safety.

Abstract the proposed split by the actual protected resource/capacity or failure path. A map preserving deployment names but erasing the shared dependency is inadequate for the claimed isolation change.

Project the artifact and consumer alternatives to the exact claim that can change their decision. A format/pedigree-only projection is too weak; an adequate narrow claim can be sufficient even if the whole design remains open.

Project the agent execution to its bounded identity/effect/recovery protocol. That abstraction can support the exact protocol property; it deliberately does not preserve arbitrary open-ended task meaning or grant authority.

Map concrete outcomes to the actual required-function event over the selected mission interval. A proxy must preserve that classification for the claim being transferred; shape-compatible pass/fail labels alone do not.

Map operational scenarios to a finite partition with its actual weights. Quantitative transfer needs the correct pushforward weights or a justified bound; simple set coverage cannot supply the operational-profile probabilities.

Abstract the repair task to its consequential access, retained-state, reassembly and validation prerequisites. A model that omits a needed access/state-transfer step may assert an impossible task; a valid task model still does not supply physical resources or measured repair time.

Abstract support resources to the prerequisites and time window of the actual repair action. Preserve information/credential validity conditions, skill, access and scheduling distinctions needed by that use; a parts-only projection is not a capacity/deadline proof.

Project the changed-premise/claim graph only by merging nodes with the same consequential dependency behavior. Equal artifact bytes do not justify merging different environmental-premise states, and unrelated edits need not invalidate a retained claim.

Choose the discriminator abstraction that preserves the consequential alternatives. In retained C14, sortedness plus sum loses the ordered-permutation distinction; the stronger acceptance predicate retains it without requiring an unrelated full-system model.

Abstract control/evidence consumers while preserving dormant and future obligations relevant to removal. Recent-use underapproximation cannot establish universal absence of need; a retained theorem can survive retirement of active checking.

Abstract policies to their feasible actions, lead times and stipulated loss values. Preserve the decision ordering or a justified sufficient bound; erasing infeasibility or action costs can manufacture a predictive-policy win.

Abstract automated diagnosis/control to the exact bounded permitted-action/interface contract. Preserve that control result while keeping learned task fidelity, shift and operating authority outside the transferred claim.

Relate the implemented/proposed transition system to the declared fault/timing/storage model. Every implementation behavior credited by the claim must map to an admitted model behavior; deleting a required crash action changes the theorem domain.

Relate the refined local operation and its observations to the coarse timeout/current-state model. Universal present-state guarantees may transfer under inclusion; exact knowledge/ambiguity claims require preserving the relevant observation fibers, not merely deleting possible past effects.

Map concrete fault behaviors to the admitted fault sets and preserve the surviving-function predicate. Deterministic containment can transfer without probabilities; a quantitative success claim additionally needs the stated measure relation.

Relate the actual aggregation/selection implementation to the declared event/context transformation. Preserve the sampled counts and their denominator/selection meaning; computation refinement does not prove population representativeness.

Map the implemented event/edge inference to the intended causal/order relation with observed and inferred edges distinct. A semantics-preserving graph transformation does not supply missing physical causal evidence.

Relate the concrete local/remote design to the selected capability/invariant specification used by the architecture comparison. Establishing that functional edge does not select an architectural or organizational cost optimum.

Relate before/after-removal behaviors on the actual residual consumer observations, including dormant obligations. Refinement of active-call traces alone need not preserve a future obligation; the intended domain decides the required relation.

Relate before/after-split behavior to the intended protected resource or failure-boundary predicate. A same-service-output relation can miss the claimed failure/capacity benefit unless that observation is included.

Relate the queue implementation to the specified enqueue/service/drop model and preserve the admitted burst/drainage observations. A safety-only bounded-occupancy relation does not supply eventual drainage or service rate.

Relate the scenario/weight implementation or partition refinement to the declared operational-profile measure. Splitting a class must retain its total mass and relevant behavior; set inclusion alone does not preserve expected loss or reliability.

Relate the expanded or implemented mode/effect paths to the actual finite failure model and selected control predicate. This can preserve the admitted analysis while leaving discovery of additional physical modes open.

Relate concrete active/standby/control transitions to the abstract surviving protection path, retaining latent and switching failures. Refining nominal success alone omits the very protection-state requirement.

Relate the refined fault-state representation and system function to the same joint law through a measure-preserving map or justified bounds. Equal marginals or unweighted behavior inclusion do not preserve the required success probability.

Relate the detection/coverage calculation to the intended fault-to-observation and latency-denominator mapping. Preserve the fault population and detection event; relabeling alarms as faults changes the ratio despite similar code.

Relate symptom/cause representations by their consequential observation-equivalence classes. A refinement may legitimately distinguish more causes, but a claimed unchanged ambiguity partition requires the stronger equivalence; a sufficient remedy need not wait for unique diagnosis.

Relate an implementation or simplification of the action comparison to the exact feasible-policy expected-loss ordering. Preserve denominators, costs and feasibility; arithmetic preservation cannot create intervention efficacy or authority.

Relate the implemented policy-cost calculation to the given renewal/survival/cost formula, with its numerical interpretation. This is a calculation edge; a software age reset cannot refine physical replacement unless that physical correspondence is separately established.

Relate the condition-triggered controller/model to the specified threshold, lead-time, feasible-action and loss semantics. A correct decision calculation preserves the stipulated policy result, not calibrated precursors or effective physical intervention by itself.

Relate feedback/status updates to the actual failure/configuration/correction/evidence linkage. Preserve identities and provenance even when status changes; a closed status is not a refinement proof of causal fault removal.

Relate actual local component guarantees to the selected journey interfaces, preserving the consumer-relevant observations. An interface refinement can be material while other conjuncts remain open; it does not enlarge the objective silently.

Relate the SLI/threshold implementation to the chosen event, denominator, window and response rule. Preserve the exact arithmetic/policy semantics, with normative acceptance and action authority remaining independent.

Relate concrete recovery to the observation-preserving abstract operation using the actual useful evidence/context resource. The relation must preserve its meaning and accessibility; heap preservation alone does not establish crash durability or original truth.

Relate the implemented discriminator to the intended acceptance predicate. The C14 weak predicate is not a refinement of full ordered-permutation correctness merely because it passes the selected example; an adequate exact local predicate can suffice.

Relate the outage-data calculation to the exact random quantity/estimand. A transformation preserving time-average availability can change durations or mission survival; retain only the quantity actually preserved.

Relate aggregate/cohort calculations to the selected population/window policy. A finer partition must retain denominators and cannot be summarized into a universal per-cohort claim from an aggregate pass.

Relate the numerical/model representation to the intended lifetime hazard or process-rate function. Preserve the particular conditional quantity and domain; a same-shaped curve is not an interchangeable hazard law.

Relate the populated failure worksheet to the substantive mode/effect/control relation behind it. Structural field completion is a weaker property; preservation of the actual control predicate is the useful refinement edge.

Relate before/after event processing to the exact count/exposure rate computation and correction hypothesis. Preserve the denominator and configuration meaning; rate arithmetic does not establish a causal intervention effect.

Relate the realized/modelled chaos experiment to its exact fault/workload/oracle specification. A correct bounded experiment can refine that specification without establishing every fault or industrial superiority.

Relate the predictive-policy implementation to the same feasible actions, timing and expected-loss comparison. A semantics-preserving decision result remains conditional on prediction and action premises, not a universal policy ranking.

Relate the finite fixed-time partition of one shared U to N(t)=floor(sqrt(t)+U). Preserve interval weights and cross-time coupling; independent resampling of U or matching only the mean is not this process refinement.

Relate the checked deterministic or statistical artifact to its exact model assertion, retaining the distinction. A deterministic finite exclusion can be preserved by the relevant behavior relation; it does not refine an arbitrary-world zero-risk claim.

The NX01 eight-world Boolean construction and the selected observation fiber are exact finite objects. Complete enumeration can establish its ambiguity/current-state contrast, not an arbitrary remote service history.
The particular supplied finite event graph and recorded clock values bound the order check. Unobserved events, physical timing and larger graphs require their own semantics or theorem.
The explicitly bounded enclosed runtime/crash/replay states are the checked object. Excluded external participants and unbounded histories are not silently included.

The supplied finite normal/exception and consumer-state table bounds the implication check. A proved authoritative local contract may already suffice without enlarging that table to unrelated effects.
The selected finite probe/capability/observer/time states, including the received readiness counterworlds, bound the verdict check. Later unobserved changes and other paths remain outside it.

The actual retained-event/selection/context table and fixed aggregation inputs are finite. Its exact computation can be checked completely; an empirical population is not thereby exhaustively explored.
The supplied event/edge graph bounds the relation computation. Complete reachability checking within it does not supply unrecorded causes or guarantee every future trace.
The explicitly supplied local/remote invariant and capability alternatives bound this comparison. Exhausting them does not enumerate every architecture or establish organizational cost.
The explicit current/dormant consumer dependency graph bounds the removal check. Completeness of graph traversal is distinct from completeness of the graph as a description of obligations.

The supplied before/after resource dependency graph bounds the isolation/capacity predicate. A complete graph calculation does not establish the physical correctness of its edges or all possible decompositions.

The exact consumer alternatives and artifact predicate are the finite discrimination problem. Completeness of the check does not give meaning to an irrelevant artifact or mandate a larger proof corpus.
The bounded agent identity/effect/recovery protocol fragment is the finite object. Open-ended task meaning, outside tools and unbounded environment behavior are excluded from its theorem.
The explicit finite required-function/mission event table supplies pass/fail examples. Complete classification verifies that table, with its interpretation as the desired mission still a premise.
The selected finite scenario partition and supplied weights bound the check. Exhausting those scenarios neither estimates their frequencies nor covers omitted operational states.
The supplied finite interface variables bound the local-to-consumer implication. Complete evaluation preserves the local conjunct even when the wider conjunction is false.

The actual finite observation/time/demand data and C01 outage records bound the estimand calculation. A regenerative long-run formula or a unique distribution is not inferred from this finite comparison.
The supplied fault/observation/latency and denominator table bounds the coverage arithmetic. The finite table is a model, not a census of every future fault or proof of ascertainment.

The received finite confusion outcomes and the three feasible-policy loss comparisons bound the decision calculation. Invented probabilities, costs, confirmation quality and action feasibility remain stipulated.

The supplied finite repair-task prerequisite/order/state-transfer graph bounds the task reasoning. Checking every represented path does not furnish physical access, human skill or observed repair-time distribution.
The finite support prerequisites and declared repair window bound the feasibility model. Actual credential validity, spares, support availability and scheduler realization remain separate.

The two actual C05 model/policy comparisons at the stated parameters are finite computation inputs. Their exact calculation does not prove all hazards/policies or physical renewal; the exponential all-parameter inequality has a separate analytic proof.
The selected thresholds, action/lead-time states and stipulated losses bound the policy calculation. Complete comparison does not establish calibrated prediction or effective physical intervention.

The explicit failure/configuration/correction/evidence records and status transitions bound the linkage check. Their completeness as records is distinct from causal correction and adequate later exposure.

The actual C06 count/exposure/censoring formula inputs bound a computation check. The 100 exposure hours or 100 demands are not a state-space bound that turns a statistical sample into exhaustive model checking.

The two C07 modes and their supplied factors bound the exact sum/transfer comparison. Checking both modes does not validate the physical acceleration law, changed mechanisms or an uninspected mode population.

The finite event/exposure/configuration records and fixed aggregation inputs bound the update check. Complete processing cannot establish representativeness, missingness assumptions or every future configuration.

The explicitly selected finite program input/state profile bounds the behavior check. Larger/unseen inputs and actual operational frequencies need their own argument; physical aging is not part of that program enumeration.
The supplied finite producer/consumer interface graph bounds the journey implication. The selected objective may close locally without requiring an invented infinite dependency chain.
The C09-style finite cohort/event/denominator table and stated threshold rule bound the computation. Checking the rule does not justify the chosen stakeholder policy or action authority.
The selected probe/observer/capability/time states bound the inference, including false-currentness alternatives. It is not a complete classifier calibration study or guarantee of future health.
NX05 exhausts eight specified local x/evidence/physical-age states for the actual reset/alias comparison. It does not cover arbitrary heaps, crash durability or truthful sensing.
The explicit control/consumer/obligation relation bounds the retirement calculation. A complete relation check cannot establish that every dormant or future obligation was supplied.
The two C01 outage patterns at the given horizon bound the counterexample. Their equal availability with different durations is exact for those inputs, without a unique mission-success distribution.
The actual C01/C09 time/demand/cohort records and windows bound the ratio/policy check. An aggregate pass does not cover every cohort or interval outside that represented table.

The selected C05 parameter calculations or specified finite lifetime countermodel are the finite objects. Derivative identities and universal population assertions require separate mathematics or evidence.
The actual C07 illustrative transformation inputs bound the computation. There is no unread handbook coefficient set or new-technology empirical population in this finite check.

The C08 before/after records with counts 10 and 5 and exposures 1000 and 100 bound the rate comparison. Exact calculation refutes the count-only inference without identifying a causal correction effect.
The supplied feasible policies, thresholds, lead times and stipulated losses bound the comparison. Complete search within them does not make predictive maintenance universally superior.

At each fixed finite set of times, thresholds partition the one U interval into finitely many exact weighted cells. This preserves the selected joint distribution; resampling U or inferring the all-time mean theorem from those checks would exceed the bound.

The selected finite permitted-action/interface and control/task-fragment states bound the automated-component check. Learned semantics, deployment shift, intervention benefit and authority are not exhausted by it.

formal_current_claim.expected_consequence: Distinguish spurious warnings, genuine witnesses and justified universal transfer.

formal_current_claim.meaning_change: Preserves native cheap finite-exhaustion alternative; does not mislabel all Alloy analyses as incomplete.
formal_current_claim.remaining_premises: Apply the named method's actual logical and semantic conditions. Native precondition fields are retained verbatim beside this qualification; a case discharges only its explicitly constructed local premises.
formal_current_claim.evidence_ceiling: Current support has the source-specific access ceiling in SOURCE_TABLE.json. Cases establish their finite constructions or stated direct deductions; no industrial effectiveness, independent replication or general optimality is inferred.
formal_current_claim.reentry: Reassess when the proposition, semantics, use, supported feature set, dependencies or material contrary evidence changes.

rules.inference: The native domain and intended claim determine which bound is meaningful and what would be required to extend beyond it. They identify when the finite object is already the whole selected model, rather than requiring endless larger runs.
